title: Skill practice — Alteplase (Cathflo) PICC occlusion (Med-Surg)
disclaimer: All patients, orders, and events in this pack are fictional and for educational practice only.
learningObjectives: Assess PICC patency (flush / blood return) with chance of occlusion
Call for alteplase (Cathflo) order when occluded; use MD callback workflow
Instill alteplase, dwell 30 minutes (then +120 minutes if needed), aspirate waste blood when restored
